question: How does the Devyāyāmala describe the god's manifestation in the role of teacher?
premises: The Devyāyāmala is cited as the source.
The statement is located in the section called the fifty-two.
The god, wishing to stand as teacher, may become tenfold.
inference: The Devyāyāmala presents the divine teacher as capable of manifesting in ten forms.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the 'fifty-two' section is not explained in this verse.
plain_english: In the Devyāyāmala, in the chapter called the fifty-two, it is said that the god, wishing to stand in the role of teacher, may appear in ten forms.
